body: If the set $A = \{1, 2, 3, 4, 5\}$ and the set $B = \{2, 4, 6\}$, find the number of members in the set $A \cup B$.

options.hint: This is the number of members in $A$.
This is the number of members in $A \cap B$.

hint: List the union and count each member once.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$n(A \cup B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A \cap B) = 5 + 3 - 2 = 6$.

## Simplified explanation

Put the sets together: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6. That is 6 members.

body: How many faces has a cuboid?

options.hint: This is only the faces you can see at one time.
This leaves out the top and the bottom.
This leaves out one face, such as the lid of a closed box.
Correct. Top, bottom, front, back and two sides.

hint: Think of a closed box.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

A cuboid has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices.

## Simplified explanation

Count the faces of a box: top, bottom, front, back, left and right. That is 6.

body: Evaluate: $\dfrac{0.036}{0.02}$

options.hint: Check the place value. This is one hundredth of the answer.
Check the place value. This is one tenth of the answer.
Check the place value. This is ten times the answer.

hint: Multiply the top and bottom by 1,000.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$\frac{0.036}{0.02} = \frac{36}{20} = 1.8$.

## Simplified explanation

Moving both points 3 places gives $36 \div 20 = 1.8$.

body: The angle formed by one complete revolution is equivalent to

options.hint: One right angle is 90°, which is a quarter turn.
Two right angles make 180°, which is a half turn.

hint: One complete revolution is 360°.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$360^\circ \div 90^\circ = 4$.

## Simplified explanation

A full turn is 360°, and each right angle is 90°. So a full turn is 4 right angles.

body: If the set $P = \{1, 2, 3, 4, 5\}$, which of the following statements best describes $P$?

options.text: Set of whole numbers up to 6.
options.hint: This would include 6, and it may include 0.

options.text: Set of counting numbers less than 6.
Set of counting numbers greater than 6.
options.hint: All the members of $P$ are less than 6.
This would include 0 and the negative integers.

hint: Counting numbers start at 1.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$P$ contains exactly the positive integers below 6.

## Simplified explanation

The counting numbers are 1, 2, 3, and so on. Those below 6 are exactly the members of $P$.

body: Which of the following numbers is the next prime number greater than 23?

options.hint: 24 is even, so it is not prime.
Correct. 24 to 28 are not prime, and 29 is.

hint: Check the numbers after 23 one by one.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

24, 26 and 28 are even, 25 is divisible by 5 and 27 is divisible by 3. 29 has no factors other than 1 and itself.

## Simplified explanation

Go up from 23. None of 24, 25, 26, 27 or 28 is prime. The next prime is 29.

hint: Subtracting a negative is the same as adding.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$-35 + 15 - 30 = -50$.

## Simplified explanation

$-(-15)$ becomes $+15$ and $+(-30)$ becomes $-30$. So $-35 + 15 = -20$, and $-20 - 30 = -50$.

body: Write 78910 correct to the nearest thousand.

options.hint: This is to the nearest ten thousand, rounded the wrong way.
The hundreds digit is 9, so round up.
This is to the nearest ten thousand.

hint: Look at the hundreds digit.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

The hundreds digit is $9 \ge 5$, so the thousands digit rounds up from 8 to 9.

## Simplified explanation

78,910 is closer to 79,000 than to 78,000.

body: Simplify: $\dfrac{2^{10} \times 3^2}{3^6 \times 2^8}$

options.hint: Correct. Subtract the powers of each number.
Subtract the powers. Do not divide them.

hint: Subtract the powers of each base.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$2^{10 - 8} \times 3^{2 - 6} = 2^2 \times 3^{-4} = \frac{2^2}{3^4}$.

## Simplified explanation

For 2, the top is larger and $10 - 8 = 2$. For 3, the bottom is larger and $6 - 2 = 4$, so that power stays on the bottom.

body: Which of the following inequalities is represented on the number line?

media.caption: Number line from −3 to 4 with an open dot at −2, a solid dot at 3 and a line joining them.

options.hint: The solid dot at 3 means that 3 is included.
The dot at $-2$ is open and the dot at 3 is solid.
The open dot at $-2$ means that $-2$ is left out.
Correct. The dot is open at $-2$ and solid at 3.

hint: An open dot leaves out the value, and a solid dot includes it.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

The segment runs between an open circle at $-2$ and a solid circle at 3, which gives $-2 < x \le 3$.

## Simplified explanation

$x$ is above $-2$, but not equal to it, because that dot is open. $x$ can reach 3, because that dot is solid.

body: Factorise completely the expression $4xy - 16x + 10y - 40$
hint: Group the first two terms and the last two terms.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$4x(y - 4) + 10(y - 4) = (y - 4)(4x + 10)$, which also equals $2(y - 4)(2x + 5)$.

## Simplified explanation

Take $4x$ out of the first pair and 10 out of the second. Both leave $(y - 4)$.

body: What is the image of 2 in the mapping $x \to 2x + 5$?
hint: Put $x = 2$ into the rule.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$2(2) + 5 = 9$.

## Simplified explanation

Double 2 to get 4. Then $4 + 5 = 9$.

body: Simplify: $3a^2b^3 \times 4a^3b$.

options.hint: This adds the numbers. Multiply them.
Multiply the numbers and add the powers.
Correct. Multiply the numbers and add the powers.

hint: Multiply the numbers, then add the powers of each letter.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$3 \times 4 = 12$, $a^{2 + 3} = a^5$ and $b^{3 + 1} = b^4$.

## Simplified explanation

The numbers give 12. For $a$, the powers $2 + 3$ make 5. For $b$, the powers $3 + 1$ make 4.

body: Find the solution set of $2x + 1 < 5$ in the domain $\{-1, 0, 1, 2, 3\}$.

options.hint: When $x = 2$, $2x + 1 = 5$, which is not less than 5.
When $x = 2$, $2x + 1 = 5$, which is not less than 5.

hint: Solve the inequality, then look in the domain.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$2x < 4$ means $x < 2$. In the domain, this leaves $-1$, 0 and 1.

## Simplified explanation

$x$ must be less than 2. From the list, that leaves $-1$, 0 and 1.

body: Find the Highest Common Factor of 48, 60 and 96.

options.hint: Correct. 12 divides all three, and 4, 5 and 8 share no other factor.

hint: Write each number as a product of primes.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$48 = 2^4 \times 3$, $60 = 2^2 \times 3 \times 5$ and $96 = 2^5 \times 3$, so the HCF is $2^2 \times 3 = 12$.

## Simplified explanation

Dividing by 12 gives 4, 5 and 8, which share no other common factor. So the HCF is 12.

body: $P =$ {odd numbers between 20 and 30} and $Q = \{23, 29\}$. Which of the following is true?

options.hint: $P$ has members, such as 21, that are not in $Q$.
$P$ has five members and $Q$ has two.

hint: List the members of $P$ first.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$P = \{21, 23, 25, 27, 29\}$. Every member of $Q$ is in $P$, so $Q \subset P$.

## Simplified explanation

$P$ is 21, 23, 25, 27 and 29. Both 23 and 29 are in $P$, so $Q$ sits inside $P$.

options.hint: When $x = 2$, this gives 3, but when $x = 3$, it gives 8.

hint: $y$ goes up by 2 each time, and starts at $-1$.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

The constant difference is 2 and the value at $x = 0$ is $-1$, so $y = 2x - 1$.

## Simplified explanation

Each step adds 2, so the rule has $2x$. When $x = 0$, $y$ is $-1$, so take away 1.

body: If $a = \begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ 4 \end{pmatrix}$ and $b = \begin{pmatrix} -3 \\ 2 \end{pmatrix}$, find $2a - b$.
hint: Double $a$ first, then subtract $b$.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$2a - b = \begin{pmatrix} 4 - (-3) \\ 8 - 2 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 7 \\ 6 \end{pmatrix}$.

## Simplified explanation

Doubling $a$ gives 4 and 8. On top, $4 - (-3) = 7$. Below, $8 - 2 = 6$.

body: Find the value of $x$ in the polygon.

media.caption: Pentagon with interior angles x, 2x, 3x, 4x and 5x.

options.hint: The angles of a pentagon add to 540°, not 180°.
This uses a total of 900°. A pentagon's angles add to 540°.
This is each exterior angle of a regular pentagon.

hint: The polygon has 5 sides, so find the sum of its interior angles.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

The sum is $(5 - 2) \times 180^\circ = 540^\circ$. Then $x + 2x + 3x + 4x + 5x = 15x = 540$, so $x = 36$.

## Simplified explanation

A five-sided shape has angles adding to 540°. The angles add to $15x$, and $540 \div 15 = 36$.

body: An article costs ₵60,000.00. The price was increased by 10%. Find the new price.
hint: Find 10% and add it on.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$60{,}000 \times 1.1 = 66{,}000$.

## Simplified explanation

10% of ₵60,000 is ₵6,000. Adding it gives ₵66,000.

body: Solve for $x$ in the equation $15 - 2x = 6$.
hint: Get the $2x$ term by itself.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$15 - 6 = 2x$, so $x = 4.5$.

## Simplified explanation

$15 - 6 = 9$, so $2x = 9$. Half of 9 is 4.5.

body: The population of Ghana was 5,000,000 in 1957. The population in 1998 was estimated to be 17,000,000. Find the percentage increase in population from 1957 to 1998.

options.hint: The increase is more than the 1957 population.
The increase is more than the 1957 population.

hint: Divide the increase by the 1957 population.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$\frac{17{,}000{,}000 - 5{,}000{,}000}{5{,}000{,}000} \times 100\% = 240\%$.

## Simplified explanation

The increase is 12 million on a start of 5 million. $12 \div 5 = 2.4$, which is 240%.

body: The angles of a triangle are in the ratio $3 : 2 : 1$. Find the value of the smallest angle.

options.hint: The ratio has 6 parts, so 1 part is 30°.

hint: The ratio has $3 + 2 + 1 = 6$ parts.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$\frac{1}{6} \times 180^\circ = 30^\circ$.

## Simplified explanation

There are 6 parts sharing 180°, so 1 part is 30°. The smallest angle is 1 part.

body: Find the Least Common Multiple (L.C.M.) of 4, 6 and 10.
hint: Write each number as a product of primes.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$\text{LCM} = 2^2 \times 3 \times 5 = 60$.

## Simplified explanation

Count in 10s until you reach a number that 4 and 6 also divide. That number is 60.

body: Convert $134_{\text{five}}$ to a base ten numeral.
hint: The place values in base five are 25, 5 and 1.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$1 \times 25 + 3 \times 5 + 4 = 44$.

## Simplified explanation

Multiply each digit by its place value: 25, 15 and 4. They add to 44.

body: A circle has a radius of 7 cm. Find its area. $\left[\text{Take } \pi = \dfrac{22}{7}\right]$

options.hint: This is $\pi r$. Area uses $\pi r^2$.

hint: Area $= \pi r^2$.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$A = \frac{22}{7} \times 7^2 = 154$ cm².

## Simplified explanation

$7 \times 7 = 49$, and $\frac{22}{7} \times 49 = 22 \times 7 = 154$.

body: Simplify: $\dfrac{1}{2} - \dfrac{2}{3} + \dfrac{3}{4}$
hint: Use 12 as the common denominator.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$\frac{6}{12} - \frac{8}{12} + \frac{9}{12} = \frac{7}{12}$.

## Simplified explanation

Change them to 12ths: 6, 8 and 9. Then $6 - 8 + 9 = 7$.

body: Solve for $x$, if $\dfrac{1}{2}x - 4x > 20$.

options.hint: Correct. Dividing by $-\frac{7}{2}$ reverses the sign.
Dividing by a negative number reverses the sign, and the value is negative.

hint: Combine the $x$ terms first.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$-\frac{7}{2}x > 20$, so $x < -\frac{40}{7} = -5\frac{5}{7}$.

## Simplified explanation

$\frac{1}{2} - 4 = -3\frac{1}{2}$. Dividing 20 by this gives $-\frac{40}{7}$, and dividing by a negative flips the sign.

body: Which of the following is equivalent to $2^2 \times 6^3$?
hint: Write 6 as $2 \times 3$.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$2^2 \times (2 \times 3)^3 = 2^2 \times 2^3 \times 3^3 = 2^5 \times 3^3$.

## Simplified explanation

$6^3$ is $2^3 \times 3^3$. Together with $2^2$, the powers of 2 add to 5.

body: The volume of water in a rectangular tank is 30 cm³. The length of the tank is 5 cm and its breadth is 2 cm. Calculate the depth of water in the tank.

options.hint: This gives a volume of 40 cm³.
This gives a volume of 50 cm³.
This gives a volume of 60 cm³.

hint: Volume $=$ length $\times$ breadth $\times$ depth.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$d = \frac{30}{5 \times 2} = 3$ cm.

## Simplified explanation

The base is $5 \times 2 = 10$ cm². Then $30 \div 10 = 3$ cm.

body: The following temperatures in °C were recorded in 7 cities in Europe: $-4$, 5, 2, 0, $-6$, $-4$, 7. Find the modal temperature.

options.hint: This value is not in the list.

hint: The mode is the value that appears most often.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$-4$ has frequency 2, and every other value has frequency 1.

## Simplified explanation

Only $-4$ appears more than once.

body: The ratio of the ages of two sisters is $4 : 3$. The elder sister is 3 years older than the younger one. How old is the younger sister?

options.hint: Correct. 1 part is 3 years, and 3 parts are 9.
This is the elder sister's age.

hint: The difference of 1 part is 3 years.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$4k - 3k = 3$, so $k = 3$ and the younger sister is $3k = 9$ years old.

## Simplified explanation

The sisters differ by 1 part, and that is 3 years. The younger sister has 3 parts, which is 9 years.

options.hint: $n^2 = 36$, so take the square root and do not halve.
Subtract 4, then take the square root.

hint: Subtract 4, then take the square root.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$n^2 = 36$, so $n = \pm 6$, and 6 is the value among the options.

## Simplified explanation

$40 - 4 = 36$. The number that multiplies by itself to give 36 is 6.

body: An angle which is more than 90° but less than 180° is

options.hint: An acute angle is less than 90°.
A reflex angle is more than 180°.

hint: Recall the names of the types of angle.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

Obtuse angles lie strictly between $90^\circ$ and $180^\circ$.

## Simplified explanation

Bigger than a right angle but smaller than a straight line: that is obtuse.

body: Arrange the following fractions in ascending order: $4\dfrac{1}{4}, 4\dfrac{1}{2}, 4\dfrac{1}{3}$

options.hint: $4\frac{1}{4}$ is the smallest, so it must come first.

hint: All have the whole number 4, so compare the fractions.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$\frac{1}{4} < \frac{1}{3} < \frac{1}{2}$, since a larger denominator gives a smaller unit fraction.

## Simplified explanation

The whole numbers are the same. A quarter is smaller than a third, and a third is smaller than a half.

body: Prices of items in a shop were reduced by 10% during a reduction sale. If a customer bought an electric fan for ₵81,000.00, what was its original price?

options.hint: The original price is higher than ₵81,000.00.
This adds 10% of the sale price. The 10% is of the original price.

hint: The sale price is 90% of the original price.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$0.9P = 81{,}000$, so $P = 90{,}000$.

## Simplified explanation

₵81,000 is 90% of the price, so 10% is ₵9,000 and 100% is ₵90,000.

body:
The marks scored by 8 pupils in a Science test are: 3, 7, 8, 6, 4, 8, 4, 6.

What is the median mark?

options.hint: The two middle marks in order are 6 and 6.
The two middle marks in order are 6 and 6.

hint: Arrange the marks in order first.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

In order: 3, 4, 4, 6, 6, 7, 8, 8. The median is the mean of the 4th and 5th values, which is 6.

## Simplified explanation

Put them in order. With 8 marks, the two middle ones are both 6, so the median is 6.

body:
The marks scored by 8 pupils in a Science test are: 3, 7, 8, 6, 4, 8, 4, 6.

What is the probability that a pupil chosen at random scored 4 marks?

options.hint: Only 2 of the 8 pupils scored 4 marks.
Two pupils scored 4 marks, not one.
Use the number of pupils, 8, as the denominator.

hint: Count how many pupils scored 4 marks.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$P(4) = \frac{2}{8} = \frac{1}{4}$.

## Simplified explanation

2 of the 8 pupils scored 4, and $\frac{2}{8}$ reduces to $\frac{1}{4}$.

body: If $y = k + ax^2$, find $y$ when $k = \dfrac{14}{5}$, $a = \dfrac{4}{5}$ and $x = 2$.

options.hint: This is the top of $\frac{30}{5}$. Divide by 5.

hint: Square $x$ before multiplying by $a$.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$y = \frac{14}{5} + \frac{4}{5}(4) = \frac{14 + 16}{5} = 6$.

## Simplified explanation

$2^2 = 4$, and $\frac{4}{5} \times 4 = \frac{16}{5}$. Adding $\frac{14}{5}$ gives $\frac{30}{5} = 6$.

body: Which of the following dimensions of a triangle form the sides of a right-angled triangle?
hint: Use Pythagoras' theorem on each set.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

The converse of Pythagoras' theorem: $5^2 + 12^2 = 13^2$.

## Simplified explanation

Square the two short sides and add. Only $25 + 144 = 169$ matches the square of the longest side.

body:
(i) Factorise completely the expression $2xy - 8x + 3y - 12$.

(ii) Evaluate the expression in (i) if $x = 5$ and $y = 7$.
hint: Group the first two terms and the last two terms.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

Substituting into the factorised form is simpler, and the original gives the same value: $70 - 40 + 21 - 12 = 39$.

## Simplified explanation

Take $2x$ out of the first pair and 3 out of the second. Both leave $(y - 4)$. Then $7 - 4 = 3$ and $2 \times 5 + 3 = 13$, and $3 \times 13 = 39$.

body:
Make $q$ the subject of the equation

$$t = \frac{1}{p} + \frac{1}{q}$$
answer:
$$\frac{1}{q} = t - \frac{1}{p} = \frac{pt - 1}{p}$$

Turn both sides upside down:

$$q = \frac{p}{pt - 1}$$

> [!answer]
> {{green:$q = \dfrac{p}{pt - 1}$}}
hint: Get $\frac{1}{q}$ by itself first.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

Check with $p = 2$ and $q = 2$: $t = 1$, and the formula gives $\frac{2}{2 - 1} = 2$.

## Simplified explanation

Move $\frac{1}{p}$ across, then write the right side as one fraction. Turning both sides upside down gives $q$.

body: Given that $u = \begin{pmatrix} -5 \\ 9 \end{pmatrix}$ and $v = \begin{pmatrix} 8 \\ 12 \end{pmatrix}$, find $3\left(u + \dfrac{1}{2}v\right)$.
hint: Work out the bracket first.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

Scalar multiplication distributes over vector addition, so this also equals $3u + \frac{3}{2}v$.

## Simplified explanation

Half of $v$ is 4 and 6. Adding $u$ gives $-1$ and 15. Multiplying by 3 gives $-3$ and 45.

body:
Ama and Kofi shared the profit earned from their business in the ratio $3 : 4$. The profit was ₵1,743,000.00.

(i) Find how much of the profit each person received.

(ii) Kofi lent out his share of the profit at a rate of 20% per annum for 2 years. Find the interest on his share.

(iii) What will be Kofi's total amount at the end of the 2 years?
hint: The ratio has 7 parts.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

$A = P\left(1 + \frac{RT}{100}\right) = 996{,}000 \times 1.4 = 1{,}394{,}400$.

## Simplified explanation

One part of the 7 is ₵249,000. Ama gets 3 parts and Kofi gets 4. Kofi earns 20% a year for 2 years, which is 40% of his share, or ₵398,400. Adding his share gives ₵1,394,400.

body: Change $243_{\text{five}}$ into a base ten numeral.
hint: The place values are 25, 5 and 1.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

A base five numeral is expanded in powers of 5.

## Simplified explanation

Multiply each digit by its place value: 50, 20 and 3. They add to 73.

body:
Using a ruler and a pair of compasses only, construct

(i) triangle $PQR$ such that $|PQ| = 8$ cm, angle $QPR = 60^\circ$ and angle $PQR = 45^\circ$.

(ii) Measure $|QR|$. Type your measurement.
hint: Bisect a right angle to get $45^\circ$.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

Angle $R = 75^\circ$. By the sine rule, $|QR| = \frac{8\sin 60^\circ}{\sin 75^\circ} \approx 7.17$ cm.

## Simplified explanation

Draw the 8 cm base. Make the 60° and 45° angles at its two ends. The arms cross at $R$, and $QR$ measures about 7.2 cm.

hint: A closed tank has 6 faces, in 3 equal pairs.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

For a cuboid, surface area is $2(lw + lh + wh)$ and volume is $lwh$. The water's height is its volume divided by the base area.

## Simplified explanation

Find the three different faces and double their total to get 15,900. Multiply all three lengths to get 135,000. The base is 2,700 cm², and $81{,}000 \div 2{,}700 = 30$.

body: A car runs on the average at 45 km to 5 litres of fuel. Calculate how many litres of fuel are required for a journey of 117 km.
answer:
Distance per litre: $45 \div 5 = 9$ km

Fuel: $117 \div 9 = 13$ litres

> [!answer]
> {{green:13 litres}}
hint: Find how far the car goes on one litre.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

Direct proportion: $\frac{5}{45} \times 117 = 13$.

## Simplified explanation

45 km on 5 litres means 9 km on each litre. Then $117 \div 9 = 13$.

body:
(i) Solve for $x$ in the inequality $\dfrac{2}{3}(2x + 5) \le 8\dfrac{2}{3}$.

(ii) Describe how to illustrate the solution on the number line.
answer:
**(i)** Multiply both sides by 3:

$$2(2x + 5) \le 26$$

$$2x + 5 \le 13$$

$$x \le 4$$

**(ii)** Draw a solid dot at 4 with an arrow pointing to the left.

> [!answer]
> {{green:$x \le 4$}}, shown by a solid dot at 4 and an arrow to the left.
hint: Change $8\frac{2}{3}$ to $\frac{26}{3}$.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

Multiplying by positive numbers keeps the direction of the inequality. The dot is solid because 4 is included.

## Simplified explanation

$8\frac{2}{3}$ is $\frac{26}{3}$. Clearing the fractions gives $2x + 5 \le 13$. So $2x \le 8$ and $x \le 4$.

body: A factory increased its production by $22\dfrac{1}{2}\%$ and produced 49,000 tonnes. How many tonnes was it producing before?
answer:
49,000 tonnes is $122\frac{1}{2}\%$ of the earlier production:

$$\frac{49{,}000}{1.225} = 40{,}000$$

> [!answer]
> {{green:40,000 tonnes}}
hint: The new production is $122\frac{1}{2}\%$ of the old.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

A reverse percentage divides by the multiplier: $1 + 0.225 = 1.225$.

## Simplified explanation

The new amount is 122.5% of the old. So 1% is $49{,}000 \div 122.5 = 400$ tonnes, and 100% is 40,000 tonnes.

body:
(a) Using a scale of 2 cm to 1 unit on both axes, draw two perpendicular axes $Ox$ and $Oy$ on a graph sheet. Mark the $x$-axis from $-5$ to $5$ and the $y$-axis from $-6$ to $6$.

(b) Plot the points

(i) $P(1, -2)$ and $Q(4, 5)$;

(ii) $P'$, the image of $P$ under a translation by the vector $\begin{pmatrix} -5 \\ 0 \end{pmatrix}$, and $Q'$, the image of $Q$ by the same vector.

(c)(i) Join $PQQ'P'$.

(c)(ii) Measure angles $PQQ'$ and $PP'Q'$.

(d)(i) Find the vectors $\overrightarrow{PQ}$ and $\overrightarrow{P'Q'}$.

(d)(ii) What is the shape of $PQQ'P'$?
answer:
**(b)(ii)** $P'(-4, -2)$ and $Q'(-1, 5)$

**(c)(ii)** Both angles measure about $67^\circ$.

**(d)(i)** $\overrightarrow{PQ} = \begin{pmatrix} 3 \\ 7 \end{pmatrix}$ and $\overrightarrow{P'Q'} = \begin{pmatrix} 3 \\ 7 \end{pmatrix}$

**(d)(ii)** Opposite sides are equal and parallel, so the shape is a parallelogram.

> [!answer]
> **(b)(ii)** {{green:$P'(-4, -2)$, $Q'(-1, 5)$}}  **(c)(ii)** {{green:both about $67^\circ$}}
>
> **(d)(i)** {{green:both $\begin{pmatrix} 3 \\ 7 \end{pmatrix}$}}  **(d)(ii)** {{green:a parallelogram}}
hint: A translation adds the vector to each point.
explanation:
## Advanced explanation

A translation preserves length and direction, so $\overrightarrow{PQ} = \overrightarrow{P'Q'}$. The angles are opposite angles of a parallelogram, so they are equal.

## Simplified explanation

Move each point 5 to the left. $PQ$ and $P'Q'$ both go 3 along and 7 up, so they are equal and parallel. That makes the shape a parallelogram, and its opposite angles are both about 67°.

body:
The following are the ages in years of members of a group:

8, 11, 8, 10, 6, 7, $3x$, 11, 11

(a) If the mean age is 9 years, find

(i) $x$;

(ii) the modal age;

(iii) the median age.

(b) Describe the bar chart you would draw for the distribution.
answer:
**(a)(i)** There are 9 ages, so the total is $9 \times 9 = 81$.

$$72 + 3x = 81$$

$$x = 3$$

**(ii)** The ages are 8, 11, 8, 10, 6, 7, 9, 11, 11, so the mode is 11.
